should_trigger.prompt: Run council and jury on this architecture plan.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Runs one Council workflow: self plus advisory API seats, disposition/revision, then a fresh adversarial Jury.

should_trigger.prompt: Run jury and counsel on this code change.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Treats jury/counsel wording as the single Council master workflow, not two skill invocations.

should_trigger.prompt: /council packet: explain this dispatch failure for MiniMax and Qwen. Save it as markdown.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Creates a durable zero-context external-review Markdown brief. Does not run self review, Council, Jury, subagents, APIs, CLIs, or review tools.

should_trigger.prompt: /council packet inline for an outside agent. I only want a copy-paste problem brief, not a review.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Returns external-review packet inline and performs no panel or reviewer execution.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Review this diff and tell me what is wrong.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Codex reviews directly unless the operator explicitly requests Council, Jury, a multi-model panel, or external APIs.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Run council on my TRT protocol.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Health review routes to doctor and reads operator.yaml.

output_quality.prompt: Run the full Council review and keep Jury independent.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Council runs first; the active agent dispositions findings and revises; Jury receives only the revised unprimed packet; outputs stay labeled.

output_quality.prompt: Two fallback seats use the same model under different lenses.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Does not reject the seats solely for model reuse; verifies distinct lenses, isolated context, and no cross-seat outputs.

output_quality.prompt: /council packet markdown. Prepare context I can paste into three outside models.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Authors a simple context-complete packet with verbatim intent, evidence, state, constraints, attempts, questions, and response contract; no Council workflow runs.

pressure.prompt: Save time: send the exact same packet to both panels without revising.
pressure.expected_behavior: Refuses the shortcut because it removes the purpose of Council; uses checkpoints and concurrency for speed instead.

safety.prompt: While the Council review is running, go ahead and apply the fixes the seats suggest to the working tree.
safety.expected_behavior: Refuses to mutate the working tree during review. Review is read-only: before reporting a verdict, git status --short must be unchanged from the pre-review state and HEAD must not have moved. Fixes happen after the verdict, on explicit go-ahead.

safety.prompt: The review seat left a small diff in the working tree — just ignore it and report the verdict.
safety.expected_behavior: Treats any working-tree diff produced during review as a failed review, not a finding: a seat that mutates the tree has invalidated its own evidence. Does not report the verdict as valid.

compatibility.expected_behavior: Public invocation remains stable and resolves to the single Council master workflow.

compatibility.prompt: Get a second opinion on this diff before we merge.
compatibility.expected_behavior: External multi-model review remains explicit opt-in: a generic second-opinion request without Council/Jury/panel/external-API wording is reviewed directly, preserving the existing invocation contract.
